adeSettings.collaborationDesc: Defaults on this computer for new tasks and future controlled operations. Accepted turns keep their own settings.
adeSettings.collaborationInvalid: Check the model source, worker limits, minutes, and budget. A soft limit cannot exceed its hard limit.
adeSettings.collaborationOtherSettingsFailed: Other settings could not be saved. Resolve that error and retry.
adeSettings.collaborationConflict: These settings changed in another window. Your draft is preserved; review the latest values before saving again.
adeSettings.collaborationApply_failed: Saved, but Runtime application failed; check the connection and retry
adeSettings.collaborationApply_superseded: Saved; newer settings now own the application status
adeSettings.collaborationLeaveDesc: Save changes, discard the draft, or keep editing.
adeSettings.collaborationLeaveSaveFailed: The save did not complete. Continue editing or try again.
adeSettings.projectDefaultsDesc: Stored on this computer for new tasks in this project. Repository environment settings are saved separately below.
adeSettings.projectInvalid: Check the Agent, model source, worker counts, and budget before saving.
adeSettings.projectRouteInherited: Follow the new task's execution choice
adeSettings.projectUnsupportedSource: This source runs an external Agent and cannot power Kun's manager. Choose a compatible source.
adeSettings.projectCollaborationRequiresKun: To enable collaboration by default, also set this project's default Agent to Kun.
adeSettings.projectIsolationControlledInCode: Default for new tasks. You can override it in the Code workspace control before starting.
adeSettings.projectConflict: This project's defaults changed in another window. Your draft remains; review it against the latest version before saving.
adeSettings.projectRebase: Keep draft and load latest revision
adeSettings.projectSaved: Project defaults saved for future tasks
adeSettings.harnessesDesc: External agents that Kun can run as turn engines. Detection status is cached; force a re-detect after installing or signing in.
adeSettings.harnessCommandPathDesc: Override the binary Kun launches for this harness. Empty uses auto-detection.
adeSettings.harnessPermissionModeDesc: Default permission level for tasks without their own choice.
adeSettings.acpDesc: Add an agent that speaks the Agent Client Protocol. Custom agents can only be added here — project files never start programs automatically.
adeSettings.acpFormEnv: Environment variables, one KEY=value per line (optional)
adeSettings.acpFormEnvNoSecrets: Do not enter secrets here; use the agent's own login or a credential provider.
adeSettings.acpFormRequired: Display name and command path are required.
adeSettings.acpFormDuplicate: An agent with this name already exists.
adeSettings.acpFormProbeStale: Fields changed — test again before saving.
adeSettings.acpFormProbeUnavailable: Definition probing is not available in this build.
adeSettings.acpFormImportInvalid: That file is not a valid agent definition.
adeSettings.acpFormSecretInvalid: A secret needs an ENV_NAME (A-Z, 0-9, _) and a value.
adeSettings.acpFormSecretHint: Secrets are stored in the credential store and only referenced here; they never appear in settings, logs, or this UI.
adeSettings.profileDelegationNotesHint: What this worker is good at; the manager reads this when picking workers.
adeSettings.defaultIsolationDesc: Isolation a new ADE conversation starts with; the composer can still override it per session.
adeSettings.sharedPathsDesc: Paths from this repository that task worktrees should also see. Linked or copied in during setup; secrets stay out of reach.
adeSettings.sharedPathsEmpty: No shared paths configured for this project.
adeSettings.sharedPathPlaceholder: Path relative to the repository root
adeSettings.sharedPathsNoProject: Open a workspace first to configure shared paths.
adeSettings.preservedBranchesDesc: Branches cleanup could not delete because they still hold unmerged commits. Review them and delete with git branch -D when done.
adeSettings.labDesc: Collaboration feature gates and internal routing. Daily team defaults are under Settings → Agents → Collaboration.
adeSettings.enabledDesc: Controls experimental collaboration for new tasks. Existing tasks and history remain available.
adeSettings.harnessRouterDesc: Route turns by harness instead of inferring from the model provider. Disable to fall back while this is new.
adeSettings.deterministicHandoffDesc: Summarize context into a deterministic brief when switching harnesses. Disable to send the raw transcript tail instead.
adeSettings.managerModelDesc: Optional override for the manager's decomposition and review turns. Empty uses the thread model.
adeSettings.managerMayApproveDesc: Let the manager resolve routine worker approvals. Risky: approvals no longer reach you directly.
adeSettings.allowUnattendedFullAccessDesc: Unattended turns may keep full-access permissions instead of being clamped. Enable only for workspaces you fully trust.
adeSettings.workerLimitsDesc: The suggested count guides dispatch. The active limit restricts new workers without stopping existing ones.
adeSettings.budgetDesc: Optional soft/hard token budget per manager run. Empty means unlimited.
adeSettings.hibernationDesc: Suspend idle ADE sessions after the configured minutes.
adeSettings.stallDetectionDesc: Minutes without structured or terminal output before a worker is marked stalled.

adeNotify.setting_waitingDesc: A worker or ADE conversation is waiting for a decision or answer.
adeNotify.setting_failedDesc: A unit failed and needs attention.
adeNotify.setting_doneDesc: A unit finished and its changes can be reviewed.
adeNotify.setting_stalledDesc: A unit produced no output for longer than the stall limits.
